g.text: Build me a small online shop with a storefront and an orders API, and run it on my laptop with Flisk.
> Build me a small online shop with a storefront and an orders API,
and run it on my laptop with Flisk.
I'll use Flisk to create the project, add both services and start them.
Running flisk resource orders-api… (esc to interrupt)
Running flisk resource shop-web… (esc to interrupt)
Running flisk up shop… (esc to interrupt)
